text: Roshii art style, a rugged, middle-aged man with a thick beard and spiky short hair stands confidently on a gritty urban street at dusk; he wears dark sunglasses, smokes a cigar emitting smoke into the air, and has tattoos covering his left arm while wearing a torn leather jacket over a white t-shirt revealing part of his chest; his right hand grips a silver pistol holstered at hip level, adorned with various pouches and gear strapped to his waistband; background features towering buildings under a hazy teal sky with neon signs glowing faintly â one red sign displays Chinese characters â evoking cyberpunk meets post-apocalyptic aesthetics; detailed brushwork mimics ink wash textures with sharp contrasts between shadowed forms and illuminated surfaces; intense gaze directed off-camera as if surveying danger ahead; overall composition emphasizes raw masculinity, solitude, and edgy survivalist vibe through dynamic lighting and atmospheric depth.
